what: DERIVATION, independent attempt 2 of 4: The odds of unformed sites for the sphere menu: its massless surface and the transverse channel beyond it. SETTING (blocks 41 and 42; open PRs titled 'ail41: what a source is when records move' and 'ail42: records interacting through the odds of unformed sites'): six-axis rule with pair weight omega = (p, q, r) for equal, opposite, orthogonal contents, T = p+q+4r, K_1 = omega/T, l1 = (p-q)/T, l2 = (p+q-2r)/T. READING (supplied by the owner, not adopted): an unformed site carries its probability distribution over the six contents, and that distribution is a condition for its neighbours. SELF-CONSISTENT ODDS: pi_x(s) proportional to the product over the six neighbours y of sum_b omega(s,b) pi_y(b); a record enters as the point mass at its content. BLOCK 42 PROVED: the derivative of the map at the uniform field is K_1 - 1/6 per neighbour; linearized, delta_x = sum_y K_1 delta_y, spectrum l_i (6 - E(k)); the lean v obeys (-Lap + m^2) v = source/l1 with m^2 = (1 - 6 l1)/l1; NO MASS TERM exactly on 5p = 7q + 4r (the triple (3,1,2) lies on it); beyond it the uniform field is unstable; existence, uniqueness and geometric decay proved for 6(1-kappa) < 1 by a contraction of the ratio metric R(x,y) = max(x/y)/min(x/y), with R(omega x, omega y) <= R/((1-kappa)+kappa R); the first-order charge a record feeds in is its content vector; with 'no record' as a seventh possibility the density channel has first-order strength rho(1-rho)(g-1)/(1+rho(g-1)), g = c/c_0, zero at the neutral scale; a record is a BOUNDARY VALUE (its odds are fixed), so the linear field of a body of agreeing records is the reaching probability of a walk killed at rate 1 - 6 l1, interior records carry the charge 1 - 6 l1, and a body's strength is its capacity, not its record count. EXECUTED: the nonlinear lean around one record follows the screened lattice Green function to four digits at range 0.77; on the massless surface r v(r) is flat at 0.28-0.30 for r = 1..5 on a 27^3 torus. TASK: repeat block 42 T2 for the unsoldered sphere menu with pair weight exp(beta s.s'). (a) The one-neighbour operator K_1 on functions on the sphere: eigenvalues by angular momentum, l = 1 eigenvalue L(beta) = coth(beta) - 1/beta; the linearized self-consistent map; the massless point 6 L(beta) = 1 (give beta to six digits) and the screened range below it. (b) Beyond the massless point the uniform field is unstable. Find the ordered self-consistent field (uniform lean M along an axis: M = L(6 beta' ...) - derive the exact self-consistency equation) and linearize around it: show that the transverse components have NO mass term at every beta beyond the point (the rotation symmetry), and give the longitudinal mass. (c) A record of content s in this ordered sea: what it feeds into the transverse channel is the part of s perpendicular to M; records aligned with M feed nothing transverse. Is the mass (record count) a source of any channel without a mass term? Prove the answer by the symmetry. (d) Records are boundary values: the capacity statement of block 42 T6 for the transverse channel. check.py: exact where rational (series coefficients), otherwise high-precision with stated error.  DELIVERABLE, in your unit worktree on ai/probes: probes/work/derive/odds-field-sphere-menu/<your worker name>/ATTEMPT.md and check.py. ATTEMPT.md: (1) the exact statement you attempt; (2) numbered steps, each marked PROVED (argument given in full), CHECKED (a finite fact check.py verifies exactly) or ASSUMED; (3) if the route fails, the FIRST step that fails and why: a precise no-go for a route is a result; (4) what would finish it. check.py: exact arithmetic (fractions, integers, sympy) for every finite claim; it prints `SUMMARY: PROVED ...`, `SUMMARY: COUNTEREXAMPLE ...`, `SUMMARY: PARTIAL <what is new and exact>` or `SUMMARY: ROUTE FAILS AT <step>`, and a line `HIT: <the claim>` ONLY when you claim a proof, a counterexample, or a new exact partial result others can build on; a HIT is handed to a worker of another model family to referee line by line, so write for a hostile reader. Rules: definitions come from the notes on the PR branches named above (git fetch origin <branch>; git show origin/<branch>:<note>; find them with gh pr view <n> --json files,headRefName); any outside theorem you use must be re-proved at the scope you use it or listed under ASSUMED; no status words (proved theorems are promoted by the supervisor after the referee). Have your own plan BEFORE reading the prior attempts printed at claim time; then either build on a refereed partial result or take a different route. Run: python3 probes/run_probe.py <task> --worker <name> --model <model> --review "..." --extra "python3 probes/work/derive/odds-field-sphere-menu/<name>/check.py"
